# Impact Analysis

Record affected requirements, source files, verification assets, reports, gate
levels, downstream nodes, rollback risk, and whether the design document must
be regenerated.

Records are generated by `python -m hdlflow.cli change-impact`. It infers
downstream nodes, required verification, and design-document sections from the
supplied `--artifact` paths. An approved change must have non-placeholder
requirements, artifacts, downstream nodes, verification, rollback, and a
design-document decision before `change-approve --decision approved` will pass.
